From: Samir Patel <samir@brightlayer.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API Eval: Request for demo — BrightLayer

Hi Marissa,

We just spun up a few evaluation tests with Redwood's Hosted API via the self-serve flow and are impressed so far. Would love a short walkthrough/demo focusing on integration patterns and latency/cost best practices — we have a small ML infra team and a product manager who'd join.

Three quick questions:
- Can you cover streaming and function-calling examples?
- Typical latency expectations for a 2k token completion?
- Any docs/papers you recommend ahead of time?

Available windows (PST): Mon–Thu next week between 10:00–12:30 or 15:00–17:00.

Thanks,
Samir
Director of ML, BrightLayer
--
BrightLayer | samir@brightlayer.ai

Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800

Hi Samir — great to hear you started a trial, congrats!

I'd be happy to run a 30-minute hosted API evaluation demo tailored to your team. I can cover streaming & function-calling, walk through latency profiles, and go over integration tips for cost-sensitive workloads.

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue Mar 2, 10:30–11:00
- Wed Mar 3, 15:30–16:00
- Thu Mar 4, 11:00–11:30

If none of the above work feel free to pick a slot on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/30min

Agenda (draft):
1) Quick intros (5m)
2) Hosted API walkthrough & streaming demo (10m)
3) Latency/cost profile & best practices (10m)
4) Next steps / mutual action plan (5m)

I've attached a short quickstart guide that covers the endpoints and sample code. Aditya (AE) is cc'd and will join for any commercial/pricing questions.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
SDR, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood-hosted-api-quickstart.pdf

Thanks for the update — 15:30–16:00 PST on Tue Mar 2 works for us. I've scheduled the 30-minute demo and added a short mutual action plan for post-demo follow ups. Calendar invite sent.

Quick notes I'll cover during the demo:
- Streaming + function calling examples with code snippets
- Role-based API keys and session scoping (we support separate keys per env/team + key rotation via KMS)
- Data retention & logging: hosted plans retain minimal logs by default; enterprise options support configurable retention and audit logs.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-template.xlsx (light template we can customize during the call).

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/HS-23874

See you Tue at 15:30 PST — calendar invite includes the Zoom link.

Best,
